editorial: The capability development of AI-based autonomous research systems and the risks posed by security vulnerabilities are at the center of the technology agenda today. While discussions on Hacker News focus on the speed of system evolution, next-generation small language models and 3D mapping technologies are coming to the fore on Hugging Face.

items.title: elementalsouls/Claude-BugHunter
items.summary: elementalsouls/Claude-BugHunter is a Claude Code capability package developed for bug hunting and red-team work processes. Written in Python, this tool allows for analysis across 24 basic vulnerability classes with 85 different capabilities and 16 command-line commands.

snapshot.description: A Claude Code skill bundle for bug hunting and external red-team work - 85 skills, 16 slash commands, 681 disclosed-report patterns curated across 24 core vulnerability classes, plus enterprise identity + infrastructure attack matrices.

items.title: obra/superpowers
items.summary: obra/superpowers is a capability framework and software development methodology developed for AI coding agents. It aims to standardize the software development processes of agents through composable capabilities and prompting instructions.

snapshot.description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works. Superpowers is a complete software development methodology for your coding agents, built on top of a set of composable skills and some initial instructions that make sure your agent uses them.

items.title: HKUDS/CLI-Anything
items.summary: CLI-Anything is a command-line interface (CLI) tool that makes software usable by AI agents. It aims to work compatibly with various AI-powered development tools such as Pi, OpenClaw, nanobot, Cursor, and Claude Code.

snapshot.description: "CLI-Anything: Making ALL Software Agent-Native" -- CLI-Hub: One Command Line: Make any software agent-ready for Pi, OpenClaw, nanobot, Cursor, Claude Code, etc. 中文文档 | 日本語ドキュメント | Deutsch

items.title: jingyaogong/minimind
items.summary: MiniMind is an open-source project that allows users to train a 64M parameter large language model (LLM) from scratch. This training process, which can be completed in two hours, offers the opportunity to develop models on personal computers with its Python-based structure.

snapshot.description: 🧠 两小时从 0 训出你的 64M 大模型。Train your own 64M LLM from scratch in 2 hours. MiniMind 以 Apache 2.0 协议完全开源、永久免费。赞助完全自愿，不换取任何特权，也不影响项目使用。感谢每一位支持者，让这个业余时间维护的项目得以持续。

items.title: cursor/plugins
items.summary: Cursor offers a repository containing technical standards for plugins developed for the code editor Cursor, as well as official plugins. Prepared in TypeScript, this resource serves as a configuration guide that allows developers to extend the platform's capabilities.

snapshot.description: Cursor plugin specification and official plugins

items.title: firecrawl/firecrawl
items.summary: Firecrawl is an information infrastructure that provides access to over 550 data providers for AI agents to work more efficiently. While offering web scraping and search operations through a single application programming interface (API), it provides flexible usage options with self-hosting capabilities and software development kits (SDKs).

snapshot.description: Knowledge infrastructure to make your agents smarter. Search, scrape and access 550+ data providers through one API. Knowledge infrastructure to make your agents smarter. 🔥 You can use Firecrawl three ways. This repo holds the code for Firecrawl Local and the self-hosted server, along with SDKs that work with all three.

items.title: nginx/nginx
items.summary: NGINX is an open-source software used as a web server, load balancer, reverse proxy, API gateway, and content cache. Developed in C, this project provides high-performance network traffic management solutions.

snapshot.description: The official NGINX Open Source repository. NGINX (pronounced "engine x" or "en-jin-eks") is the world's most popular Web Server, high performance Load Balancer, Reverse Proxy, API Gateway and Content Cache.

items.title: openvinotoolkit/openvino
items.summary: OpenVINO is an open-source toolkit used to optimize and deploy the inference processes of AI models. Developed in C++, this platform ensures that models run efficiently on different hardware.

snapshot.description: OpenVINO™ is an open source toolkit for optimizing and deploying AI inference. Check out the OpenVINO Cheat Sheet and Key Features for a quick reference.

items.title: cathrynlavery/diagram-design
items.summary: cathrynlavery/diagram-design offers 52 different types of diagram designs prepared for AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Factory Droid, Qoder, and Pi. The project provides an alternative visualization method to standard diagram tools with its HTML and SVG format visuals that do not contain external dependencies.

snapshot.description: Editorial diagram design for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Factory Droid, Qoder, and Pi. 52 diagram types. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.

items.title: mvanhorn/last30days-skill
items.summary: mvanhorn/last30days-skill offers an AI skill that summarizes topics by conducting research on Reddit, X, YouTube, Hacker News, Polymarket, and the general web. Developed in Python, this tool aims to provide the user with a grounded summary by synthesizing data collected from different platforms.

snapshot.description: AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web - then synthesizes a grounded summary

items.title: google-labs-code/stitch-skills
items.summary: stitch-skills, developed by Google Labs, is an agent skills library designed to work compatibly with the Stitch MCP server. This library follows open skill standards to ensure compatibility with software such as Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, and the code editor Cursor.

snapshot.description: A library of Agent Skills designed to work with the Stitch MCP server. Each skill follows the Agent Skills open standard, for compatibility with coding agents such as Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Cursor.

items.title: mjmirza/app-store-compliance
items.summary: mjmirza/app-store-compliance is a guide that offers 125 different rejection patterns and solution suggestions to reduce app store rejection reasons. The project includes 117 deadline trackers for following legal compliance processes and a custom skill set for AI coding agents.

snapshot.description: Avoid common App Store and Google Play rejections. Open playbook and pre-submission guard with 125 documented rejection patterns and fixes, privacy manifest and Data safety checks, 117 tracked deadlines (EU AI Act, DSA, COPPA, age laws), and a skill for AI coding agents.

items.title: Tracer-Cloud/opensre
items.summary: Tracer-Cloud/opensre is an open-source AI agent designed to increase the reliability of continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) processes. Developed in Python, this tool can pull current builds directly from the root directory without requiring administrator privileges during the installation process.

snapshot.description: The open-source agent for CI/CD reliability. The installer fetches the latest build from main without requiring sudo. If opensre is not found, follow the PATH instructions printed by the installer or open a new terminal.

items.title: toeverything/AFFiNE
items.summary: AFFiNE is an open-source knowledge base that combines planning, editing, and content creation processes into a single platform. Developed as an alternative to popular tools like Notion and Miro, this software offers a privacy-focused and customizable workspace.

snapshot.description: There can be more than Notion and Miro. AFFiNE(pronounced [ə‘fain]) is a next-gen knowledge base that brings planning, sorting and creating all together. Privacy first, open-source, customizable and ready to use.

items.title: XiaoYouChR/Ghost-Downloader-3
items.summary: Developed in Python, Ghost-Downloader-3 is a comprehensive file downloader that runs on four different platforms and supports various download protocols. Originally designed for a content creator's resource management needs, the project now has an extensible ecosystem with feature packs.

snapshot.description: The only downloader you need. 下载器的集大成者。. Started as a passion project to help a Bilibili creator manage resources. Now it ships on four platforms, handles virtually every download protocol, and has a growing Feature Packs plugin ecosystem.

items.title: zhouxiaoka/autoclip
items.summary: zhouxiaoka/autoclip is an open-source desktop video editing tool that converts long videos into short content. This AI-powered application automates the video preparation process by generating subtitles, cover images, and social media captions.

snapshot.description: The open-source OpusClip alternative — local-first AI clipping & MCP server, zero subscriptions. AutoClip｜一个链接，一键出片。开源 AI 视频剪辑桌面工具，将播客、访谈、课程等长视频自动剪成短视频，生成字幕、封面和发布文案，适配抖音、小红书、TikTok、Reels 与 YouTube Shorts。

items.title: Holy shit holy shit holy shit holy shit: The magnitude of what’s now happening
items.summary: The blog post shared by Scott Aaronson discusses recent developments in the matrix multiplication exponent. The post highlights the significance of new findings regarding the solution to this mathematical problem.

snapshot.description: See also The matrix multiplication exponent is nine fourths [pdf] - https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50637220

items.title: 1Password Security Incident
items.summary: Password manager 1Password announced that a security incident was detected in its backend systems. It stated that customer vaults were not affected by this situation and remain secure.

snapshot.description: 1Password identified a security incident involving some of our backend systems. Customer vaults were not accessed and remain secure.

items.title: Much shorter version of GRH Lean verification from Anthropic
items.summary: grh-lean, shared by lsernau, presents a shorter verification process for the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis on the mathematical proof software Lean 4. This work introduces a new approach in the field of formal verification of complex mathematical propositions.

snapshot.description: A short Lean 4 proof of the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis - lsernau/grh-lean

items.title: The New York Times warns photographers not to update Photoshop over AI features
items.summary: The New York Times is warning photographers not to update the image editing software Photoshop due to its AI features. The organization expresses concerns about the potential impact of these tools on copyrights and ethical standards.

items.title: thinkingmachines/Inkling-2-Mini
items.summary: thinkingmachines/Inkling-2-Mini, shared on Hugging Face, is a multimodal AI model that processes text and image inputs to produce text output. It is designed for general-purpose use in English and other languages, as well as various programming languages.

snapshot.description: image-text-to-text model. Inkling 2 Mini is a general-purpose multimodal model that accepts text and image inputs and generates text outputs. It is intended for use in English and other languages, and across multiple coding languages.

items.title: unsloth/Inkling-2-Mini-GGUF
items.summary: unsloth/Inkling-2-Mini-GGUF, shared on the Hugging Face platform, is an AI model that converts visual and text inputs into text output. Users can train this model with the Unsloth library or use it via llama.cpp, a tool for running large language models on local devices.

snapshot.description: image-text-to-text model. You can also train Inkling 2 via the latest version of Unsloth or run via llama.cpp. See an example of 4-bit Inkling Mini running in Unsloth in Blender + MCP:

items.title: inworld/voice-isolator
items.summary: inworld/voice-isolator, shared on Hugging Face, is an audio-to-audio model that produces audio output from audio input. Inworld Voice Isolator v1 consists of two different models that share the same architecture.

snapshot.description: audio-to-audio model. Inworld Voice Isolator v1 ships as two models that share one architecture:

items.title: AtomicChat/Inkling-2-Mini-Uncensored-GGUF
items.summary: Inkling-2-Mini-Uncensored-GGUF, developed by AtomicChat, is an uncensored artificial intelligence model capable of processing image and text inputs. Offered in GGUF format, this model is accessible via ready-to-use files that users can run on their own systems or as LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) adapter options.

snapshot.description: image-text-to-text model. An uncensored build of thinkingmachines/Inkling-2-Mini by AtomicChat (26.4B MoE, 3.4B active, looped core; text and image input; Apache-2.0, LICENSE in this repo). It comes as a LoRA adapter for any GGUF of AtomicChat/Inkling-2-Mini-GGUF and as three ready-made GGUF files with the edit baked in. Every gate we hold it to is measured below, and the two it misses are shown.

items.title: SulphurAI/Sulphur-3
items.summary: Sulphur-3, developed by SulphurAI, is an uncensored video generation model based on MiniMax H3. It offers users the ability to create videos without content restrictions.

snapshot.description: An uncensored video generation model based on MiniMax H3.

items.title: GOLD-SLAM: Gaussian-splatting Omnidirectional LiDAR-Depth SLAM
items.summary: GOLD-SLAM is a Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) system that resolves the discrepancy between the wide field of view of panoramic cameras and the limited data of LiDAR sensors. It combines high-quality rendering with precise geometric reconstruction by performing global tracking and mapping.

snapshot.description: Panoramic cameras capture nearly the entire spherical field of view in a single frame. However, the mismatch between this panoramic coverage and the field of view of LiDAR poses a substantial challenge for panoramic Gaussian splatting SLAM that relies on LiDAR depth priors. We introduce GOLD-SLAM, a Gaussian-splatting Omnidirectional LiDAR-Depth SLAM system that combines high-quality rendering with accurate geometric reconstruction. items.title: Demystifying the Autoresearch Harness: How Context and Skills Shape Self-Evolving Agents
items.summary: The article shared by Hugging Face examines the mechanisms affecting the performance of self-evolving agents that autonomously conduct scientific research. The study addresses the contribution of context management and capabilities to system success in long-term experimental processes with a systematic approach.

snapshot.description: Autoresearch agents, which autonomously design, run, and refine experiments, are accelerating scientific progress, particularly in AI research. However, existing agents rely on harnesses that combine multiple mechanisms, making it difficult to determine how individual components contribute to performance. We systematically study harness design for long-horizon, self-evolving autoresearch agents along two dimensions: context management, which determines what an agent retains from its past attempt

items.title: Efficient Video Retrieval Augmented Generation via Token Allocation
items.summary: The article shared by Hugging Face introduces a framework called Lembas, developed to reduce the computational load in understanding long videos. This method treats the RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) process—a method that enables AI to generate answers by retrieving information from current and specific data—as a token allocation problem between frames and subtitles.

snapshot.description: Efficient long-video understanding requires identifying relevant evidence while minimizing the tokens processed by vision-language models (VLMs). Existing video retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) methods rely on frame selection and token compression, but overlook how much each additional token is worth. items.title: Evaluation-Free Recursive Self-Improvement for Coding Agents
items.summary: The article shared by Hugging Face discusses AI agents that write code iteratively improving their own implementations. The study proposes an evaluation-free self-improvement process as an alternative to evaluation-based selection methods used to achieve performance gains.

snapshot.description: Recent self-improving coding agents have achieved strong benchmark performance by iteratively modifying their own executable implementations. A common pattern uses downstream task-derived evidence to decide which candidates or lineages continue evolving, which we term evaluate-and-select. items.title: Letting Models Manage Their Own Context: Where We Stand
items.summary: The article shared by Hugging Face examines a new approach where AI models manage their own context. Tested on NVIDIA's open-source agent development tool nooa, this method allows the model to decide for itself which information to summarize via an application programming interface (API).

snapshot.description: Agent harnesses today manage context on the model's behalf: when the window fills, the harness triggers a compaction that summarizes the history. We study the alternative, model-driven context management, in which the model itself decides when and what to compact through a context API. glossary.explanation: A systematic work process aimed at finding bugs and security vulnerabilities in software.
A controlled security audit conducted by acting like an attacker to test the security of a system.
An organized work environment that provides the basic structures, rules, and tools used while developing software.
A text-based interface that allows you to manage programs by typing written commands instead of using a mouse.
An artificial intelligence model trained on a vast amount of data that can understand human language and generate text.
The process of copying data from websites using automated methods and saving it in a different format.
An interface that acts as a bridge, enabling different software programs to communicate and exchange data with each other.
A set of tools and code that facilitates the development of applications by programmers for a specific platform or service.
A tool that prevents system overload by distributing incoming internet traffic evenly across multiple servers.
An intermediary server that handles requests from the internet, directs them to the relevant servers, and enhances security.
A type of software whose source code is open for anyone to access, inspect, and improve.
The process of a trained artificial intelligence model making predictions or performing analysis on new data.
A specialized capability that an artificial intelligence possesses to perform a specific task.
A collection of ready-to-use capabilities that artificial intelligence agents can utilize to perform complex tasks.
A process that ensures software updates are automatically tested and deployed to production quickly and securely.
Modular plugin packages used to enhance the core features of a software or to add new functionalities.
